Package eu.algites.lib.common.object.props.labels

Annotation Interface AIaFieldLabel

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target({FIELD,METHOD,RECORD_COMPONENT}) public @interface AIaFieldLabel
Declares semantic labels for fields, record components and getters.

Role codes distinguish stable field names, display titles and explanatory descriptions, independently of rendering purpose, format and locale. A simple label() supplies the default text for roleCode(); labels() supplies additional role/locale/purpose/format variants. Resolver factories use CategoryProviderDiscovery and are selected by specialized factory SPI, category and optional provider ID, never by reflective resolver constructors. An empty category and provider ID leave an optional resolver disabled.

    • roleCode

      String roleCode
      Semantic field-text role of the primary literal label. This is not a rendering purpose and does not change locale or presentation format selection.
      Returns:
      the title role unless explicitly overridden
      Default:
      "field.name"

    • label

      String label
      Literal fallback text for the primary roleCode(). An empty value means no literal fallback; additional texts can be provided by labels() with independent role/purpose/format/locale variants.
      Returns:

      Default:
      ""
